'''Danny Kramer''' is an American actor for the English [[dub]] of {{aniseries|JN}}. He is currently affiliated with DDO Artists Agency.

==Biography==
Kramer is an American voice actor born on April 3, 1990. After working on TV and film, Kramer became a voice actor and was heard in several commercials before working on Pokémon. Kramer's most notable role so far is that of [[Hammerlocke]] [[Gym Leader]] [[Raihan]].

==Pokémon roles==
====Humans====
* [[Raihan]]
* One of [[Nito]]'s henchmen

==Other non-Pokémon roles==
* Nico (''{{wp|The Prince of Tennis II Anime OVA}}'')
* Kaboom (''{{wp|Mobile Legends: Bang Bang}}'')
* Oni (''{{wp|Orient}}'')
* The Shepherd/Kenneth Drayden (''{{wp|Yu-Gi-Oh VRAINS}}'')
